must_fix.problem: Once subprocess.Popen starts the own attached Docker child, inspect-live can raise before process.wait. The outer exception handler then writes failed execution and returns without collecting that actual child wait. This is a real exception-control-flow gap, not proof that any child currently leaked.
must_fix.required_change: Guarantee process.wait and original attached stdout/stderr/returncode recording in a finally region for every successfully created attached child, even if intermediate inspect fails. Retain the original inspect failure and failed status. Wait for natural completion; no kill, remove, restart or retry is required.

scope: Only the new protocol host wrapper. The independently reviewed protocol harness itself is unchanged and has no static must-fix. Actual resources have not been started by this review.
